Job Description: Title: Marketing Intern – Finland (Part-Time, Fall Semester) Company: Wolt Location: Helsinki Region, Finland URL: https://fi.linkedin.com/jobs/view/marketing-intern-%E2%80%93-finland-part-time-fall-semester-at-wolt-4430027230 Posted: 2026-07-01 Deadline: Open until filled Reason: The role is a marketing internship, which fits Manju's profile and experience. However, it is explicitly part-time (20 hours/week) for only the fall semester. ======================================== JOB DESCRIPTION: ======================================== LinkedIn kunnioittaa yksityisyyttäsi LinkedIn ja kolmannet osapuolet käyttävät välttämättömiä ja ei-välttämättömiä evästeitä palvelujemme tarjoamiseen, suojaamiseen, analysointiin ja parantamiseen sekä osuvien mainosten näyttämiseen sinulle (mukaan lukien ammattilais- ja työpaikkailmoitukset) LinkedInissä ja niiden ulkopuolella. Lisätietoja on evästekäytännössämme. Hyväksy ei-välttämättömien evästeiden käyttö valitsemalla Hyväksy tai estä niiden käyttö valitsemalla Hylkää. Voit päivittää valintasi milloin tahansa asetuksista. Hyväksy Hylkää Hyppää pääsisältöön LinkedIn Työt Poista teksti Poista teksti Kirjaudu sisään Liity nyt Marketing Intern – Finland (Part-Time, Fall Semester) Wolt Helsinki 1 viikko sitten 28 Hakijoiden Katso, kuka Wolt on palkattu tähän rooliin Hae Tallenna Arvioi sopivuuttasi tekoälyn avulla Hanki tekoälypohjaisia neuvoja tähän työhön ja muita eksklusiivisia ominaisuuksia. Olenko sopiva tähän työhön? Räätälöi ansioluetteloni About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Location : Helsinki, Finland Team : Local Marketing Reporting to : Marketing Specialist / Marketing Manager Duration : September–December 2026 (12 weeks) Hours : 20 hours per week or as otherwise agreed At Wolt, we're building the leading local commerce platform across Europe and Asia, helping people discover and get what they need, quickly and reliably. Marketing plays a key role in how we connect with customers, support local merchants, and bring our brand to life across channels. From local campaigns and social media initiatives to content creation and influencer collaborations, we are constantly looking for new ways to engage audiences and create meaningful customer experiences. As part of Wolt's Fall Semester Internship Program, we're looking for an ambitious final-year university student to join our Marketing team and gain hands-on experience working on real marketing initiatives with visible business impact. About The Role This is not a traditional internship focused on observation and administrative support. As a Marketing Intern, you will support the execution of commercial and content marketing initiatives at the local level. Working closely with Marketing Specialists and Managers, you'll help bring campaigns to life by coordinating and executing tasks, preparing content, and assisting with operational and creative execution across multiple channels. This role is ideal for a student interested in pursuing a career in marketing, communications, social media, or consumer technology. What You'll Be Doing Campaign Execution & Content Coordination Assist in creating, localizing, and publishing marketing content across multiple channels, including in-app banners Use internal tools to help set up campaigns, schedule content and upload marketing assets Support the localization of global and regional marketing materials for the Finnish market Track campaign setup tasks and checklists to ensure assets are ready and campaigns are delivered on time Creative & Content Production Collaborate with designers and content creators by preparing briefs, managing asset versions, and coordinating feedback Help organize marketing assets and ensure content is accurate and ready for launch Collect and organize user-generated content (UGC) for use across social media and campaign channels Social Media & Influencer Marketing Help schedule and publish content on local social media channels under the guidance of the Marketing Specialist or Manager Assist with influencer outreach and campaign coordination Organize product deliveries, collect campaign content and coordinate timelines for influencer collaborations Cross-Functional Coordination Assist in uploading and maintaining materials related to local merchant campaigns Coordinate timelines between the marketing team and other internal stakeholders to support the smooth rollout of initiatives What We're Looking For Must Have Currently in the final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree Strong interest in marketing, communications, social media, or consumer technology Excellent organizational and coordination skills Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously Strong communication skills in English and Finnish Proactive attitude and willingness to learn and take ownership Nice to Have Previous internship, student organization, or project experience in marketing, communications, business, or startups Experience with social media platforms and content creation Familiarity with project coordination and stakeholder management Interest in technology, e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer brands What Success Looks Like By the end of the internship, you will have: Contributed to the successful delivery of multiple local marketing campaigns Supported content creation and campaign execution across various marketing channels Developed practical experience in campaign operations, social media and influencer marketing Built strong stakeholder management and project coordination skills Gained hands-on experience working in a fast-paced marketing environment Why this role matters This internship is designed to give talented students meaningful responsibility while helping Wolt identify future marketing talent. You'll gain practical experience across campaign execution and measurement, social media, influencer and content marketing, as well as marketing operations, while working on projects that directly impact how Wolt grows in Finland. High-performing interns may be considered for future full-time opportunities following graduation. Why join Wolt? Work on real projects with visible business impact Learn from experienced marketing professionals Gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of marketing Collaborate with teams across Marketing, Creative, Commercial, and Operations Build practical skills that accelerate your marketing career Create a pathway toward future full-time opportunities at Wolt Next steps If you're excited about learning how modern marketing works, developing practical experience, and making an impact while you study, we'd love to hear from you. After submitting your application, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile. If it looks like a good fit, you'll go through a short interview process with the hiring manager and team. The process is designed to be transparent, efficient, and give you a real sense of what working at Wolt is like. Please note that we do not accept applications sent by email, please submit your application through our careers website. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. paragraphs: Olen kirjoittanut soittamaan hakemuksesta Marketing Intern – Finland (Osa-aikainen, Syyskausi) -tehtävään Woltin joukossa. Mahdollisuus työskennellä kansainvälisen sopimus- ja IP-oikeuden parissa maailmankuulessa yrityksessä on juuri sellainen oppimisympäristö, johon olen törmännyt - ja minulla on vahva tunne, että koulutukseni tekee minut vahvaksi ehdokkaaksi.

Minulla on LL.M. Business & Corporate Law (Symbiosis International University, 1. sija) ja käytännön kokemus sopimusdokumenttien laatimisesta ja neuvottelemisesta yritys-oikeudellisen käytäntöpraktikan yhteydessä. Poise Legal -yhtiössä Intiassa vahvistin kuukausittain 5-7 kauppaneuvoa, sopimusneuvoa ja toimintasopimuksia sekä tarjoushetkellisiä sopimuksia tueksi neljälle yritysklientille samalla kun tein yhtiöoikeudellista ja sopimus-oikeudellista tutkimusta.

Olen juuri suorittamassa OPH-tuntemuksia koskevia lisäopintoja Lapland University -yliopistossa, mikä osoittaa sitoutumistaan integroitua kansainvälinen oikeusosaaminen Suomen oikeusjärjestelmän kanssa. Toimien sekä englanniksi että suomeksi, minulla on hyvä kommunikaatio- ja työskentelytaito molemmissa kielissä.

Woltin sisäisesti - työskentelemällä rinnakkain GC:n kanssa ja saavuttamalla näkymät yrityksen oikeudellisiin operaatiosiin - on tarkalleen se oppimisympäristö, johon minulla on tarvetta. Olen saatavilla syyskauden alusta asti ja voin sitoutua osa-aikaisesti akateemisen vuoden aikana, siirtyen täysihoitoon kesän aikana.
Arvostan mahdollisuutta keskustella siitä, miten voisin auttaa teijäsi joukossa.
